content:
Agent-scoping implementation complete (commit: feat(agent-scoping)). All success criteria met.

1. DECISION CHECKPOINT (criterion 1, landed first): recorded in docs/adoption-log.md and docs/decision_log.md — insufficient evidence (trial opened 2026-07-11), project-model decision deferred, soft domain tags remain, revisit condition = human-confirmed multi-project usage in the adoption log. Human may override at any time.

2. TESTS: 472/472 (48 new across test_agent_keys, test_scoping_rest, test_scoping_mcp), ruff clean. Coverage per plan: key generation/format/hash; resolve valid/revoked/unknown/non-prefixed; management command (plaintext printed once and only the hash stored — asserted; duplicate name and invalid slugs rejected; revoke; list prints no secrets); scoping primitives (owner passthrough returns input UNCHANGED incl. None; injection; explicit allowed-domain selection unchanged; out-of-scope rejection both directions; visibility incl. untagged-invisible-to-agents and owner-sees-all); REST — valid/revoked/unknown key auth, last_used update, zero-rows dev mode open, write injection (201 with domain:domain-a injected), cross-domain write 403, ingest 403, cross-domain invisibility on list/explicit-tags(403)/detail(404)/patch(404)/delete(404)/stats/tags, owner surface sees all 3 incl. untagged, search constrained to default domain + explicit disallowed 403; MCP — verifier matrix (owner claims for global key, agent claims + last_used for agent key, revoked/garbage/empty -> None), build_auth matrix (open only when no global key AND no active agent keys), current_agent revoked -> ScopeError, no-context -> None, and per-tool enforcement: store injection/rejection, get/update/delete not-found (with the blocked update verified to leave the row untouched), find_related seed blocked, list_recent constrained, get_stats total=1 with no cross-domain tags, list_domains restricted, ingest tools rejected. Back-compat: full pre-existing 424-test suite passes untouched semantics (only two prior tests updated across the phase, both to reflect the new verifier class name and after= kwarg from earlier phases — none in this one).

3. LIVE TWO-KEY DEMO (criterion 3, transcribed): created demo-agent-a (demo-a) and demo-agent-b (demo-b) via the management command; restarted both servers. REST as A: store with no tags -> tags ['domain:demo-a'] (id 1e5441e1-...); write into domain:demo-b -> 403. REST as B: list -> 0; detail of A's memory -> 404; stats total -> 0; tags -> domain:demo-a absent; explicit ?tags=domain:demo-a -> 403. Owner (dev-mode, no key): sees A's memory. MCP as A (bearer key): store ok; cross-write -> 'Scope error: domain(s) not allowed... demo-b'. MCP as B: get_memory(A's) -> not found; list_recent -> none; search_brain tags=[domain:demo-a] -> Scope error; get_stats -> total 0; list_domains -> none. Anonymous MCP with keys present -> HTTP auth rejection. Demo artifacts cleaned up afterwards and open dev mode verified restored.

4. HARDENING FOUND DURING THE LIVE DEMO: build_auth originally gated on AgentKey.objects.exists(), which would have kept MCP locked after all keys were revoked/deleted; changed to filter(is_active=True) (covered by the build_auth matrix test) and re-verified live that deleting the demo keys restores open dev mode.

5. DOCS: README scoping section rewritten — per-agent keys with the enforcement contract, the note that the MCP server picks up its first key at startup (restart required), the owner surface documented as intentionally unscoped, and the residual-surfaces table replaced (all formerly unscoped surfaces closed for agent principals); workflows.md agent-key section; .env.example note.

6. Committed intentionally on main per repo convention.

Out of scope honored: no workspace column (deferred by the checkpoint), no per-key throttling, no dashboard multi-user auth, no agent-gate integration.

The implementation leaves one agent-scoping bypass on the REST surface.

`PATCH /api/memories/<id>` checks whether the caller can currently see the memory, but if the payload includes `tags`, it passes them straight into `memory_service.update_memory()` without running `scoping.check_write_tags()` first. An agent that owns a memory in an allowed domain can therefore retag it into a disallowed domain, strip all `domain:` tags entirely, or otherwise move it outside its scope. That breaks the core write contract and creates rows that become invisible to all agent principals after the write.

Code path: `api/views.py`, `MemoryDetailView.patch`.

Requested change:
- Route patched `tags` through the same write-enforcement helper used by create and ingest.
- Preserve the existing semantics: explicit out-of-allowed domains return 403, no silent rewrite of a caller-supplied domain tag.
- Add REST regression tests covering at least:
  - agent patching an in-scope memory to `tags=["domain:other"]` -> 403 and row unchanged
  - agent patching an in-scope memory to tags with no domain -> allowed only if that is the intended contract and it is explicitly enforced; otherwise reject and assert unchanged
  - owner/anonymous patch behavior remains unchanged

I reran `.venv/bin/pytest -q` (472 passed) and `.venv/bin/ruff check .` (clean); the gap is behavioral and currently untested on the REST patch path.

PATCH bypass closed (commit fix(agent-scoping)): MemoryDetailView.patch now routes patched tags through scoping.check_write_tags — the same helper as create/ingest — after the visibility check. Semantics preserved exactly as requested: explicit out-of-allowed domains return 403 with the row asserted byte-unchanged; no silent rewrite of caller-supplied domain tags (allowed domains kept verbatim). The no-domain case is the enforced intended contract, matching MCP update_memory: the agent's default domain is injected, so a PATCH can never strip a row out of every agent scope — asserted by test including post-patch visibility. Four REST regression tests added: retag-to-disallowed -> 403 + unchanged; domain-stripping -> default injected + still visible; retag within allowed domains -> tags kept verbatim; owner/anonymous patch -> raw passthrough with no injection. 476/476 tests, ruff clean.
